analysis: The PR is console-ui only and touches TB-004 (browser to coordinator via BFF). In useFleetData.ts the optional /api/me/summary fetch is split from the required /api/me/providers fetch. Each account session now tracks providersInFlight and summaryInFlight, so at most one summary request is pending per session. Both requests reuse the same Authorization header and same-origin relative URLs (PROVIDERS_URL and SUMMARY_URL, lines 13-14), so no new credential destination or SSRF surface (T-017) is added. Account-switch isolation holds. The summary result is applied only when sessionRef.current === session and the summary signal is not aborted (head lines 127-129). The effect cleanup aborts both controllers (lines 166-170), and a new session gets fresh controllers. The first-render clearing via emptySnapshot(accountKey) is unchanged, so one account's summary cannot appear for another account. Residual: the summary request has no timeout, so a stalled response occupies the single summaryInFlight slot until abort or settle. This is bounded and availability-only, and it no longer blocks fleet loading or polling. The test changes add an HTTP loopback test and unit tests, and add fixture fields to a withdrawal test; none touch production code paths. The changelog entry is documentation. No coordinator, provider, attestation, billing, or App Attest code changed, so T-052..T-058 and the TB-002/TB-009/TB-011 assumptions are unaffected. No findings.
